name: George G. Meade
desc: Commander of the Army of the Potomac. Meade directed the defense of the Union fishhook line and coordinated reinforcements across the battlefield.

name: James Longstreet
desc: Lee's senior corps commander. Longstreet directed Confederate attacks against the Union left flank on July 2.

name: Winfield Scott Hancock
desc: Commander of Union II Corps. Hancock reinforced threatened sectors and helped stabilize the Union line.

name: Daniel Sickles
desc: Commander of Union III Corps. His advance to the Peach Orchard created a dangerous salient that became a focal point of Confederate attacks.

name: Joshua Chamberlain
desc: Colonel of the 20th Maine. Chamberlain's defense of Little Round Top became one of the most famous actions of the battle.

name: Devil's Den Fight
desc: Intense fighting erupted among the massive boulders of Devil's Den as Confederate forces pushed against the Union left flank.

name: Wheatfield Fight
desc: The Wheatfield changed hands repeatedly as both sides launched attacks and counterattacks throughout the afternoon.

name: Little Round Top Defense
desc: Union troops defended Little Round Top against repeated Confederate assaults, preserving the Union left flank.
